topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: The moment I saw the ring, a familiar weight settled in my chest. It was my grandmother’s engagement ring, the one with a single diamond that glinted just so in the shop’s soft lighting. I traced the outline of the band with my finger, recalling the stories she told of how my grandfather had chosen it, the way she would laugh as she spoke of their early days. The pawn shop was quiet, and for a moment, it felt as if I were simply borrowing a cherished piece of her, one I could return after a long conversation. I decided to take it home, to keep it close, and maybe, just maybe, understand a little more of the life she led before it was my turn to carry on her legacy.
